data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to detect barcodes using Google MLKit API for Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides a camera preview widget capable of scanning barcodes in real-time using Google MLKit. Exposes a controller to manage scanning parameters like flash, zoom, crop area, and detection delays.
use_when: You need real-time barcode scanning using Google MLKit in a Flutter application.
You want camera controls like zoom, flash toggling, and custom crop overlays for scanning.
avoid_when: You only need simple static QR code generation without scanning.
You need text, face, or object detection features that are not yet fully implemented or supported by this specific plugin.
strengths: Provides a ready-to-use widget with built-in camera controls and flash management.
Supports configurable detection delay to optimize CPU consumption.
Allows custom crop overlays and camera zoom.
weaknesses: The plugin is explicitly noted as under development, and some APIs might not be available yet.
Documentation mentions detection of text, faces, and objects in the description, but only barcode scanning is shown in the API support table.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSCameraUsageDescription to ios/Runner/Info.plist and setting the minimum Android SDK version to 21 in android/app/build.gradle.
